subject.title: feat(cron): shell precheck gate to skip LLM when no work

question: Should OpenClaw add and support a persistent Gateway-host shell precheck as a first-class cron-job contract, rather than directing conditional scheduling through the existing trigger/script and command-payload mechanisms?
rationale: This is a new durable protocol field and CLI surface that changes the supported security and operator model; code review cannot choose whether that permanent core API is the intended product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the precheck contract
options.body: Accept `job.precheck` as an owned cron API after Gateway end-to-end authorization and upgrade proof is added.

options.title: Use existing cron mechanisms
options.body: Decline the new shell-precheck contract and document or improve trigger/script and command-payload workflows instead.

options.title: Narrow the direction first
options.body: Request a small design decision on precheck semantics and ownership before reviewing the broader CLI and statistics additions.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the precheck contract
recommendation.body: Accept `job.precheck` as an owned cron API after Gateway end-to-end authorization and upgrade proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects core Gateway scheduling, durable protocol compatibility, and the repository's stated security-first product direction.
